race.title: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Maiden
race.verdict: STOOKED can't have been right at Roscommon last time so provided Ger Lyons' filly is ready to roll back from a 3-month break, she's fancied to go one better than on her first couple of outings in July. Otsana took a step forward when runner-up over 7f here a fortnight ago so she may emerge as the main threat, while Joseph O'Brien looks to have a strong hand and Brise Fraiche looks the best of his quartet. STOOKED (IRE) OTSANA (IRE) BRISE FRAICHE
